name: Bazelisk
description: Bazelisk includes detached-signature verification with an embedded Bazel release key for designated official release channels. Other configured channels differ; the evidence does not support one authentication classification for every source.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot, not the historical Bazelisk revision under study.
The review establishes the Bazelisk call-site policy and embedded-key check, but not release-server key custody or the authenticity of the remote signature itself.
